statements.text: Following months of negotiations, the United States and Korea reached the Korea Strategic Trade and Investment Deal in July 2025. After publishing a joint fact sheet on November 13, the U.S. government implemented the adjusted tariffs agreed upon by the two countries.

If Section 232 tariffs on unmanned aircraft systems and polysilicon take effect on September 3 and December 4, respectively, a portion of U.S. imports from Korea currently subject to U.S. MFN or preferential tariff rates under the KORUS FTA will face a 15 percent tariff, net of MFN duties.
A 15 percent tariff, net of MFN duties, under Section 232 on the automotive sector applies to 214 automobiles and auto parts based on 8-digit HTS codes.
The United States reduced its Section 232 sectoral tariffs on automobiles, auto parts, timber, lumber, and wood derivatives to 15 percent on an MFN-inclusive basis.

Consistent with the spirit of the 2025 trade deal between the two countries, the United States recently decided to apply a 15 percent tariff, net of MFN duties, to polysilicon and its derivatives, as well as unmanned aircraft systems and their components originating from Korea.
